title: Securities Transfer Tax — modernisation of the Stamp Taxes on Shares Framework
text:
Stamp Duty and Stamp Duty Reserve Tax are collectively known as Stamp Taxes on Shares.

 They will be replaced with a single tax on transfers of securities.

 The Securities Transfer Tax, which will be a modern, digital, self-assessed tax, will be introduced in 2027.

 Draft legislation has been published on 13 July 2026. Send your feedback about the draft legislation to sts.consultation@hmrc.gov.uk by 7 September 2026.
